source: the constants fixed in the paper: the defect bounds delta0, delta1, delta2 of the lemmas on F_0, F_1, F_2 in Section 5; the contraction factor q0 = q1 = q2 = 0.998 of Section 6, also used for T_1 and T_2 in Section 7; the radius r, written epsilon_0 in the existence proposition of Section 6; the constants A (alpha_0 in the paper), alpha1, alpha2, alphaf of Section 7 and the curvature margin 0.089 of its lemma on the concavity of u_0. Collected into this file when the package was assembled in October 2026 from the authors' convexity component. operator_mode 'raw' records that the certified operator norms are the plain bounds on T_0, T_1, T_2, not bounds that already include the factor r x/u_0(x); the earlier component assembly supported both conventions. convexity/closure.c declares the same decimals, which run.py checks.
